name: USFWS wildlife crime tip line
region_note: WILDLIFE REPORTING LINES - who to call about sick, dead, stranded or illegally kept wildlife. Reporting lines only: for a live injured animal use the wildlife carers above.
notes: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service tip line (1-844-FWS-TIPS) for suspected wildlife crime: killing or trapping protected birds and animals, selling wildlife or wildlife parts, or crimes on federal refuges. Reports can be anonymous. For cruelty to a pet or ordinary animal in New York City call 311 or 911 instead; for hunting or fishing violations off federal land, DEC Region 2.
type_raw: Federal law-enforcement tip line for suspected wildlife crime - trafficking, killing or selling protected species; a reporting line that does not collect animals
